text:
A month ago I posted that it's an era of collaboration, not competition in F&O and algo trading.

The conversations since then have been eye-opening. A few patterns came up again and again:

1. The best traders talk about risk before returns.
2. Infrastructure (static IPs, APIs, execution, margin) is the most underrated bottleneck.
3. Many traders have idle portfolios that could support their trading more efficiently through pledging, within the rules.
4. Compliance is no longer optional. Since SEBI's algo framework went live, the serious players welcome it.
5. Nobody scales alone.

To every trader, developer and quant who reached out: thank you. 🙏

If we haven't connected yet and you're a serious trader in F&O, algo, MFT or quant, my DMs are open. Let's see what we can build together in 2027.

Repost so it reaches someone who should be part of this conversation. 🔁

#AlgoTrading #FnO #OptionsTrading #NSE #StockMarketIndia #Collaboration #SeriousTraders #2027

—
Darshil Shah | DDS Capital
